title: Transit network
summary: 25 transit kiosks link the services, places and quarters of the city: free, instant, open from the start.

blocks.text: Walk to a transit kiosk and hold its prompt: the network's window opens, with a live view of the city and the open rifts. Pick a stop (or search a place), then TRAVEL : you are there at once, with no loading screen. It is free . Not during a fight: wait a few seconds after a hit. Stay by the kiosk while you choose; the network recharges for a moment between two trips. Mark up to 12 stops as favourites ; the nearest kiosk is always shown in the city with its distance. Keyboard: click a stop, ↑ ↓ to browse, Enter to travel, Esc to close. Gamepad: D-pad, A to travel, Y for a favourite, B to close.
